title: Curate legacy config matrix and collapse rollout-version mapping
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: Over several years we accumulated a matrix of rollout configuration keys and two incompatible rollout API versions (v0 and v1). This matrix causes confusion (multiple canonical keys for the same behavior), increases code paths in the router, and complicates canary & rollback behavior. Goal: curate the legacy config matrix into a single canonical schema and collapse the rollout-version mapping so runtime uses a single versioned surface (v2). Non-goals: removing unrelated feature flags, changing rollout semantics, or large UI/Console redesigns. This ticket is the infra+runtime work to collapse the mappings and provide a short translation shim for external clients.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Runtime only reads canonical config schema (v2) in prod after migration window.
2) A small, well-tested translation shim accepts v0/v1 payloads and emits v2 for 14 days post-rollout and can be removed by ENG-23111.
3) No increase in error rate or 95th latency on the rollout router (compare pre/post canary).
4) All Console routes continue to render existing datasets; UI migration tracked separately.
5) DB schema migration completes without downtime and has a rollback path.
6) Documentation updated (Confluence + Runtime API spec) and PRs merged.
plan: Phase A: Audit & mapping (complete) - Inventory keys, identify duplicates, and create canonical mapping table. Phase B: Implement canonical read path and translation shim behind feature-flag. Phase C: Canary rollout (10% traffic) + monitor. Phase D: Gradual cutover + migration of persisted configs, remove shim after stabilization. Phase E: Cleanup sub-issues and follow-ups.

risks_mitigation: Risk: Translation shim may miss edge cases causing dropped rollouts. Mitigation: Extensive integration tests using production-like fixtures + dry-run mode that logs untranslated mappings to a review table. Risk: DB migration may cause brief stalls. Mitigation: rolling index creation during low-traffic window and pre-warming indices in staging. Rollback: feature-flag off returns system to previous behavior.
testing_plan:
1) Unit tests for mapping and translation (coverage target 95%).
2) Integration tests with rollout router using synthetic traffic.
3) Staging dry-run: apply migration script with logging and reconcile counts.
4) Canary: 10% traffic for 48 hours; automated alerts for error rate > baseline+2x or p95 latency > baseline+25ms.
5) Post-canary validation: compare rollout outcomes between old-vs-new translation on a mirror traffic run.
